text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2% over the past day, with Bitcoin holding firmer relative to smaller altcoins like Solana, which has dropped 5%. The Fear & Greed index sits at 20—extreme fear territory—though it's risen 9 points over the week, suggesting some stabilization in sentiment despite the current drawdown. Volume remains healthy at $76B with Bitcoin dominance near 56%, indicating traders are rotating into the largest assets during uncertainty rather than abandoning the market entirely.
